test_Stl10Test: test the Stl10Test class that validates the STL10 dataset builder with train, test, and unlabelled splits
build_Builder: build the STL10 dataset builder that downloads and generates image-label examples from train, test, and unlabelled splits
test_split_generators: test the split generators for train, test, and unlabelled splits of the STL10 dataset
test_generate_examples: test the _generate_examples method that yields image and label dicts from STL10 binary files
test_info: test the _info method that returns dataset features with 96x96 RGB images and 10-class labels
